title: George Hincapie’s Son and Another Rising American Teen Are in Red Bull’s WorldTour Pipeline. How Far Can They Go?
content:
Enzo Hincapie moves up to Red Bull’s U23 Rookies and Jack Klau joins the junior team. Could the American teens one day race with Remco Evenepoel?

Read the full article at George Hincapie’s Son and Another Rising American Teen Are in Red Bull’s WorldTour Pipeline. How Far Can They Go? on Velo.
